title: Categorized Enchanted Books
description: Categorizes Enchanted Books via an icon on the texture denoting the items it is applicable on.
body:
This resource pack adds icons to enchanted books to easily display what items the book is applicable on.
# Main Icons
### Diamond Sword
Sword Enchantments
- Bane of Arthropods
- Fire Aspect
- Knockback
- Looting
- Sharpness
- Smite
- Sweeping Edge
### Diamond Pickaxe
Tool Enchantments
- Efficiency
- Fortune
- Silk Touch
### Arrow
Bow and Crossbow Enchantments
- Flame
- Infinity
- Power
- Punch
- Multishot
- Piercing
- Quick Charge
### Diamond Chestplate
Armor Enchantments
- Blast Protection
- Fire Protection
- Projectile Protection
- Protection
- Thorns
### Diamond Helmet
Helmet Enchantments
- Aqua Affinity
- Respiration
### Diamond Leggings
Leggings Enchantments
- Swift Sneak
### Diamond Boots
Boots Enchantments
- Depth Strider
- Feather Falling
- Frost Walker
- Soul Speed
### Mace
Mace Enchantments
- Breach
- Density
- Wind Burst
### Trident
Trident Enchantments
- Channeling
- Impaling
- Loyalty
- Riptide
### Fishing Bobber
Fishing Rod Enchantments
- Luck of the Sea
- Lure
# Miscellaneous Icons
### Experience Orb
- Mending
### Anvil
- Unbreaking
### Omen Cloud
- Curse of Binding
- Curse of Vanishing
